prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: deep magenta. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: four leaning folders; a paper hand.
Opens on the tall column, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip is covered as the column topples into four leaning folders; a paper hand enters and steadies them.
Ends holding on the steadying hand.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "EXECUTION RISK".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "EXECUTION RISK". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Integration execution across those four businesses is the primary risk.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage in a cinematic, live-action style, photographed as a flat lay under soft, natural room light from the upper left. <Picture 1> establishes the scene: a deep magenta, single-color paper ground filling the frame. In the upper third, a cream-colored paper chip with rough torn edges displays the black, extra-bold sans-serif text "$8.1M G&A". In the lower two-thirds, several stacks of black-and-white halftone photographic paper cutouts of coins, each with a thin white torn-paper edge, form a rising column. Every element casts a small, soft shadow to the bottom right.

Immediately on the first frame, the camera remains in a Static Shot. A new cream paper chip slides in from the top, quickly covering the "$8.1M G&A" chip; it is printed with the stable, accurate black text "EXECUTION RISK". Simultaneously, the column of coin cutouts topples over with a slight overshoot, transforming and rearranging into four distinct, leaning folders. These folders are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn edges and no markings or text on them. As the folders settle, a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of an anonymous paper hand enters from the right edge of the frame with a fast motion, sliding in to steady the leaning folders. The hand and folders hold their position for the remainder of the video. All surfaces maintain a matte printed paper texture with no glow or neon effects. A narrator (S1), a male with a warm, clear, and natural timbre and a brisk but unhurried speaking rate, speaks: <d>[English] Integration execution across those four businesses is the primary risk.</d>

A distinct, light paper-slap occurs as the "EXECUTION RISK" chip lands, followed by a series of soft, overlapping paper rustles and thuds as the coin column topples and the folders lean.
